title: No Client Commands
description: A Fabric mod to prevent annoying mods from registering their client-side commands.
body:
# No Client Commands
So many of my mods register client commands like `/fzzy_config`. I will use Mod Menu if I want to open their menu. It's just annoying.

So this fixes it!
Server commands still work as normal.

Also has a whitelist if Mod Menu and YACL are installed.
